then.text: Enjoy the pie dish! If the dragon wants a matching gravy boat, I've got one with a crack in.
A pie dish big enough for a dragon? I have exactly that. Victorian, stoneware, made for a harvest supper for sixty.
Take it. Anyone feeding a knucker needs all the help they can get. Bring it back if it survives.

else.text: Everything in here has a story. That clock was in a Hove hotel for ninety years. That mirror was in a pier ballroom. That chair is just a chair.
The Lanes have been full of antique dealers since after the war. Jewellers before that. Fishermen before that. We all came for the view and stayed for the rent.
